'''Gas Extractor''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A facility that can extract Inergen and other gases. It does not require power to work.|Those companies would never realize why Endfield Industries bought up all those vacuum cleaner patents.}}
==Usage==
A facility that can extract [[Inergen]] and other gases, such as [[Xiragen]].
*It does not require power to work, as it uses natural flow of gas to extract gases.

==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC_Factory_Plan#Wuling_AIC_Plan|Wuling AIC Plan - Wuling AIC II - Gas Extraction]]
{{RecipeTable|product=Gas Extractor}}

==Trivia==
*In the version preview for [[Sketches of Lost Heirlooms]], the Gas Extractor was first shown with the name "Assimilator" printed on the case.
